definitions.gloss: to get tired of, to lose interest in
definitions.explanation: To become bored with something due to repetition or excess.

examples.japanese: この{仕事|しごと}に{飽|あ}きた。
examples.english: I got tired of this job.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{同|おな}じことで{飽|あ}きない？
examples.english: Don't you get tired of the same thing every day?

examples.japanese: {飽|あ}きずに{続|つづ}けてください。
examples.english: Please continue without getting tired of it.

notes:
{飽|あ}きる means to become bored or tired of.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜に{飽|あ}きる: to get tired of ~
- {飽|あ}きっぽい: easily bored, fickle
- {飽|あ}きない: not get tired of
- {飽|あ}きずに: without getting tired

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- うんざりする: to be fed up
- {退屈|たいくつ}する: to be bored

Note: Ichidan verb (る-verb).
